title: pvDelaunay2D
body:
## pvDelaunay2D

Full native Delaunay 2D: triangulates input points (vtkPointSet) into polydata triangles. Beyond delaunay2D it exposes ProjectionPlaneMode — XY Plane (default) ignores z, Best-Fitting Plane projects the points onto their least-squares plane first so tilted, nearly planar sets triangulate correctly — and Offset and BoundingTriangulation, which control the initial bounding triangulation. Alpha and Tolerance act as in delaunay2D (ParaView defaults 0 and 0.00001).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Best-Fitting Plane suits roughly planar data only; strongly curved point sets still fold.
- BoundingTriangulation true adds the artificial bounding points and triangles to the output; it is a debugging aid.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Delaunay2D`. Identity: `filters/Delaunay2D`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset to the Delaunay 2D filter. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Alpha` | The value of this property controls the output of this filter. For a non-zero alpha value, only edges or triangles contained within a sphere centered at mesh vertices will be output. Otherwise, only triangles will be output. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `BoundingTriangulation` | If this property is set to 1, bounding triangulation points (and associated triangles) are included in the output. These are introduced as an initial triangulation to begin the triangulation process. This feature is nice for debugging output. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Offset` | This property is a multiplier to control the size of the initial, bounding Delaunay triangulation. | `{"minimum":0.75,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.75` |
| `ProjectionPlaneMode` | This property determines type of projection plane to use in performing the triangulation. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY Plane","Best-Fitting Plane"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"XY Plane"` |
| `Tolerance` | This property specifies a tolerance to control discarding of closely spaced points. This tolerance is specified as a fraction of the diagonal length of the bounding box of the points. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvDelaunay2D",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
